claim_as_stated: Seattle Foundation makes ACH mandatory for grants from 2026-06-30
exact_values_found: 'Effective June 30, 2026, organizations must be enrolled in ACH Transfer to receive future grant payments.' Page does not mention donor-advised funds
discrepancies: None on the quoted rule. Web searches surfaced no other Seattle Foundation statement of the rule; the repo already notes the donor FAQ still says checks are cut within a week

claim_as_stated: DAFpay Donor Terms (dafpay.com/donor-terms-of-use, eff. 2025-09-24): credential use + triggering 2FA; $1,000 liability cap; no use on behalf of third parties; no agent clause; privacy policy says credentials 'not stored' yet 'segmented storage of all Credentials'
exact_values_found: Terms: consent to Chariot 'triggering the transmission of any two factor authentication codes'; liability capped at 'ONE THOUSAND U.S. DOLLARS (US $1,000)'; may not 'use DAFpay on behalf of or to provide services to third parties'; no mention of bots/agents/automation/AI. Privacy: 'DAF Provider Donor Credentials are not stored'; 'one time secure pass through'; 'We maintain segmented storage of all Credentials for an additional layer of security.'
interpretation_challenge: 'No agent clause' should be read as no clause on third-party or AI agents: the Terms do say 'you hereby authorize Chariot to take the following actions on your behalf', i.e. Chariot is itself an authorized agent of the donor

source_date: FY2024 990 (filed 2025-09-04); FY2025 990 (filed 2026-09-02); goodstack.io and giftall.org live 2026-11-14
exact_values_found: FY2024: DonorAdvisedFundsHeldCnt 7268; VlEOY 1,812,959; contributions 2,945,016; grants 1,210,123; total assets 1,984,371.
